value.rationale: This identifies a canonical maximal infinite-dimensional closed operator ideal with robust nonattainment, not merely an isolated nonattaining operator. The optimal half-norm separation creates a sharp and measurable distinction between norm attainment relative to the disk-algebra operator algebra and unconstrained operator approximation. The coincidence of both failed extrema and exact flat four-width profiles is structurally motivated by the Hardy boundary and illustrates a concrete boundary in operator norm-optimization geometry.
